Metadata.title: Find a proven social solution
Metadata.description: Describe a problem in your own words and we will point you to proven social innovations from the ROPS Kraków library.

Footer.tagline: The Social Innovation Hub connects the needs of Małopolska residents with proven solutions.
Footer.sourceNote: Data comes from the public Social Innovation Library of ROPS Kraków. Every result links to its source.

hero.title: Describe the problem. <highlight>Find a solution</highlight> that already works.
hero.lead: A few sentences are enough – we show proven innovations and explain why they fit.
